title: Gravity Falls Theme
blurb: Mysterious, a little rickety, and stuffed with the same secrets as the show itself: Brad Breeck's Gravity Falls theme even hides a whispered cryptogram at the end, which fans spent years decoding frame by frame. Alex Hirsch built a series in which every background concealed something, and the title sequence was the first puzzle you were handed. It has since become one of the most beloved cartoon themes of the 2010s. Play it whenever something around here does not quite add up.
origin: Brad Breeck's opening theme for Gravity Falls (Disney, 2012).
